arrow_mind.description: You do not provoke attacks of opportunity for firing a bow in threatened squares. You can make attacks of opportunity with your bow.

snipers_eye.description: Allows you to make sneak attacks and death attacks at a range of up to 60 feet. Also grants darkvision and the ability to see through cover.

blindsight.description: Subject gains blindsight out to 30 feet, allowing them to pinpoint creatures without vision.

aura_of_evasion.description: Grants the evasion class feature to all allies within 10 feet. Allies who already have evasion gain +2 bonus on Reflex saves.

baleful_transposition.description: Two target creatures swap locations. Both must fit in the destination space, otherwise the spell fails.

critical_strike.description: Your next melee attack deals +1d6 sneak attack damage. If the attack hits, it also doubles the critical threat range of your weapon.
